correctness.rationale: Re-ran compute_pentas.py: density, covolume, window area, W_F pentagon (5 vertices, rel spread 6e-16, AWF 0.4793945971, freq 0.0623058987 matching (9*sqrt5-20)/2 to 5e-16) and triple FT (F0=|W|, |F(q1)|=1.0099874707, I1=7.7298289264) reproduce. BUT essential inferences fail: (1) 'shortest dual vector / first 10-fold wavevector' n=(2,0,-2,3),|k1|=0.111 is FALSE in the stated CPS. Exhaustive search to |ni|<=12 finds 10-fold orbits at |k|=0.06860537 (5,-5,3,0) and |k|=0.04240045 (-5,0,5,-8) with I~1.88 and ~0.009, so the labeled peak is not first/shortest; Fourier module pi_parallel(L^0) is dense so no shortest non-zero vector exists and 'first' is ill-defined without a cutoff/intensity threshold. (2) Single edge-1 decagon Minkowski CPS equivalence to Pentas P3* is asserted not proved: paper uses 5D hypercubic scheme with 5 ADs and 3D internal space; claimed 'same total area' is numerically false (7.694 vs 5*sin72*(1+tau^2)=17.205=sqrt5*7.694) and freq reconciliations (inner-11 intersection already tau^-4=0.1459 vs paper S1 share (3-sqrt5)/10=0.0764) do not derive. V=21-offset S1 second-shell encoding (S1 vs S2 thin-rhomb distinction) has no tiling-generation or coordinate cross-check. (3) Exact radicals e^2=45-20sqrt5 and freq formula are float-fit identifications (Q(sqrt5) search), not analytic proof; intensity is numeric (~7.73) not exact closed form required by 'exact' target. Pure-point certificate is correct conditionally (regular model set => Hof-Schlottmann-Moody/Baake-Moody) but does not rescue the above.

originality.rationale: Full fused retrieval (20 results, all providers ok, no partial failure) plus full-text inspection of the decisive primary source Fujita-Niizeki Sci Rep 15:41523 (PMC12644897) and preprint arXiv:2505.14013, plus Mazac patch-frequencies method (arXiv:2212.09406, Acta Cryst 2023) and decagonal/model-set literature shows no prior states or implies the headline numbers (9*sqrt5-20)/2 ~0.0623 for the 21-offset second-shell flower patch, nor |F|~1.0099874707 / I1~7.7298 at the stated (2,0,-2,3) orbit, nor a regular-pentagon W_F with e^2=45-20sqrt5. Paper gives only S1 vertex-class pentagons radius 1/tau and qualitative tau^2 enhancement and 2/sqrt5 area cover, not second-shell patch frequency or any window-Fourier intensity. Standard Hof/Baake-Moody pure-point theory and Mazac dualisation cover methods, not this new-tiling application. Synonymous (Pentas/P3*, S1/flower-center, Z[zeta]/A4, decagon/pentagon, dual/complement) and broader-census/database checks found no covering theorem, table, or database entry.

value.rationale: The headline type - exact frequency of the characteristic two-tiered five-petaled flower-center patch of the just-published (2025) natural Pentas/P3* tiling plus Bragg intensity and pure-point certificate - is independently motivated before computation: paper foregrounds flower motifs covering 2/sqrt5~89.4% area, tau-scaling tenfold rhombic tiling distinct from P3 by folded/straight grid and six prototiles, and tau^2 S1 enhancement. An exact Q(sqrt5) frequency and calibrated first-ring intensity for that named motif is precisely the kind of narrow exact invariant (order/constant/witness) the STANDARD says can be retrievable without a new general theorem, and a future quasicrystal/diffraction researcher could reasonably need it. It is not a textbook restatement, mere parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. Value therefore passes as a question/result-type even though correctness currently fails.

residual_risks: If the single-decagon Minkowski CPS were eventually proved to generate exactly the Pentas LI class and V proved to encode Fig2b S1-vs-S2 correctly, the numeric frequency 0.0623058987 and FT values would become correct computations, but shortest/first wavevector labeling would still need redefinition due to dense Fourier module.

Exact closed form (9sqrt5-20)/2 currently rests on floating-point polygon clipping plus Q(sqrt5) fit (5e-16); exact algebraic-geometry proof not supplied, leaving a small misidentification risk despite 50-digit FT evidence (which does not certify the window intersection).

No independent tiling-generation cross-check (e.g. frequencies by counting in large Pentas patches or comparison with 5D AD sections) was provided; residual risk that V includes/excludes wrong outer-shell vertices.
